answer: Clone farms fail when enrollment needs a one-shot botanical witness that cannot be copied. The applicant harvests a measured nectar sample from a registered hive at first dawn, then passes it through a serialized prism so the 11-band spectrum is hashed with the address and posted within seven minutes. Filing costs 0.27 POA plus a 16 POA bond held 10 epochs. Auditors replay the spectrum against the hive log, confirm the slot is exclusive, and match the prism serial. A reused hive slot, a late stamp, or two keys sharing one serial seizes both bonds and retires that hive for four epochs.
